scope: Read-only engine/dataflow/selection/export source review and actual input Parquet schema inspection before launch. No real-data fit, inference, label decoding, or engine execution in this review.
reviewer_independence: Reviewer did not implement engine.py or verify_completion.py. Reviewer authored transport.py; its separate independent root review is linked, so this is not a claim of independent reimplementation of transport mathematics.

checks.reference_semantics: PRIMARY/RECENT use saved champion p_reference. latest/test read final calibrated p and rename it to p_reference; final caches' own p_reference is correctly not used.
checks.actual_application_schema: Observed final latest/test prediction, coverage, and evaluation schemas contain all projected keys/power/night/cosz/cloud columns, with Asia/Seoul timestamps. Latest full prediction/coverage rows4416, daylight feature rows2594; test full rows17520, feature rows9617. Engine joins one-to-one, verifies all daylight features, fills night solar only.
checks.fit_boundary: Engine passes only PRIMARY 2023-06-01<ts<=2024-06-01KST to transport.fit; model is persisted before recent read; replay/predict receive frames without y/smp/k.
checks.chronology_limit: Champion weather coefficients already used full PRIMARY. Engine and protocol explicitly label PRIMARY in-sample and RECENT development selection. This is not all-lineage OOF or an untouched holdout.
checks.physical_design: Temporal scenarios conserve KST hour-ending day/group energy; spatial scenarios conserve hourly G1+G2. Convex nonidentity mass is bounded per fixed forecast-only context. Engine independently checks capacity, night, finite values and family-specific conservation before scoring and export.
checks.training_objective: Monetary L1 normalized by reference W, coefficient penalty0.0005, training month/group W at most1.001reference. No alpha refit. Partial-fit marker prohibits automatic retraining; completed results require matching saved artifact hashes.
checks.predefined_coverage: Exactly12 predefined arms. Completion refuses selection unless every declared arm has a completed result; empty eligible set is explicitly NO_QUALIFYING_RECIPE.
checks.selection: Eligible thresholds: primary<=1, recent<=.9999, recent calendar-quarter worst<=1.005, recent group worst<=1.001, physicalPASS. Rank recent ratio, then worst recent-quarter ratio, then fixedID. At mostone candidate.
checks.future_label_barriers: Selection/model/protocol hash is persisted first; both latest and test saved predictions and their hashes are frozen next; first March-May y/smp/k decode occurs below both barriers. Later audit neither changes candidate nor coefficients. Retry checks same selection/prediction hashes.
checks.export: New candidate directory only, refuses partial-existing candidate. Protected composition bytes unchanged, keys17520 aligned, cached champion reference rounded3decimals exactly matches original forecast, candidate rounded3decimals, validator self-check required, original best hash checked by protocol.
checks.late_diagnostic_policy: Late ratio>=1 marks NOT_RECOMMENDED; otherwise remains UNSCORED_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_OFFICIAL_EVALUATION. No official upload or official score assertion.
checks.synthetic_test_source_coverage: Reviewed nofit engine tests cover primary-only fitting, label-free prediction, no refitting completed/partial trials, tamper refusal, all12 requirement, empty shortlist, both-freeze-before-late-decode, and immutable resume after audit. Separate transport11 synthetic tests previously passed.
checks.protocol_release: All seven engine source_paths entries currently exist; prepare must run only after final source tree and reviews are frozen. Any later source hash change invalidates this review's exact-byte scope.

limits: Source/schema review does not replace fresh runtime preflight, actual data preparation checks, or independent external terminal verification.
Existing higher-level deployment references were inherited; exact byte pins and comparison to protected original ZIP are mandatory.
Conservation is checked on full-precision model predictions; mandatory three-decimal CSV rounding can introduce bounded quantization differences.
All historical periods were already exposed and multiple candidate comparisons remain development selection; no actual official improvement is claimed.
